# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.2.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 0.2.0 | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within `wxec`, please do not report it through public GitHub issues.

Instead, please send an advisory report to the maintainers via GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting on the repository security tab.

Please include:
- Description of the vulnerability.
- Steps to reproduce or proof-of-concept.
- Potential impact and affected policy tiers.

We will acknowledge receipt within 48 hours and work with you on a coordinated fix.
